name: Giant Gecko
source: Pathfinder #1: Burnt Offerings pg. 89, Bestiary 3 pg. 186
body:
All | Unique
Lizard, Giant Gecko
An oversized lizard the size of a horse scans the area, its bulging eyes darting this way and that, completely independent of one another. Every few moments a long pink tongue snaps from its wide mouth, either to snatch up some unseen insect or moisten an eye.
Giant Gecko CR 1
Source Pathfinder #1: Burnt Offerings pg. 89, Bestiary 3 pg. 186
N Medium animal
Init +8 ; Senses darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision, scent; Listen +2, Spot +2
Defense
AC 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +4 , Ref +5 , Will +2
Offense
Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
Melee bite +2 (2d4+1)
Space 5 ft. , Reach 5 ft.
Statistics
Str 13 , Dex 15 , Con 12 , Int 2 , Wis 14 , Cha 6
Base Atk +1 ; Grapple +2
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Balance +10, Climb +22; Racial Modifiers +8 Balance, +8 Climb
Ecology
Environment any warm forest or mountains
Organization solitary, pair, or nest (3-6)
Treasure none
Advancement 3-7 HD (Medium), 8-14 HD (Large)
Special Abilities
Expert Climber (Ex) The unique physiology of gecko feet allow geckos to climb any surface, no matter how slick or sheer. In effect, giant geckos are treated as constantly being under a natural version of the spell spider climb. This ability also provides them with an additional +8 bonus on Climb check, which stacks with their racial bonus.
Description
Oversized lizards, giant geckos rarely threaten creatures larger than dogs or halflings. Known for their relative intelligence, some savage humanoids employ them as watchdogs or sometimes even mounts.
